newsitem.title: USA: GM hires new advertising executive.
newsitem.headline: GM hires new advertising executive.

text.p: General Motors Corp said Tuesday it hired Judy Hu as director of advertising resources management, a new position at the automaker's North American Operations (NAO).
Hu was previously with the advertising firm of D'Arcy, Masius, Benton & Bowles in Bloomfield, Hills, Mich., where she was senior vice president and director of strategic planning.
From 1987-90, GM said Hu served in senior management positions at Leo Burnett in Hong Kong, working on the United Airlines, Kellogg, Glad-Lock bags and Dairy Farm Foods accounts.

Hu, who joins GM December 1, will serve as a creative consultant to NAO's marketing and advertising functions and GM's seven marketing divisions. She reports to Phil Guarascio, GM vice president and general manager of marketing and advertising for NAO.
GM and other automakers have increasingly turned to marketing and advertising executives outside of the automobile industry as they focus on increasing awareness of their individual vehicle brands.
